intent: codex plugin first release for existing configured stable installations
objective: A working independently versioned plugin using the already configured supported Runtime, preserving current data/credentials and owner authorization, with real Desktop and public-byte reinstall verification.

exclude: Full Runtime6.5/Expert2.4/Harness4.8.3 upgrades and original R3 100% claim
Public executor/collector first delivery or private project-extensions redistribution
Fresh suite install, automatic stop/upgrade/data adoption/rollback or historical data copying
Global Host enforcement or preventing native tools; no private Codex IPC
Unrelated source, daily data, credentials, global model settings or retired Suites

acceptance.criterion: Explicit selected plugin and submitted instruction activates only that bridge; passive list/init and ordinary-chat control start no Runtime.
requiredEvidence: Actual current-source tests and criterion-specific owner/Host/artifact receipts; no synthetic or structural-only substitution

acceptance.criterion: Configured registered stopped launchd service starts once on explicit start; concurrent start and later chats reuse actual known PID; no automatic stop or unknown-process takeover.
requiredEvidence: Actual current-source tests and criterion-specific owner/Host/artifact receipts; no synthetic or structural-only substitution

acceptance.criterion: Registration pins service/plist/program/package; authenticated Runtime scope/version plus actual listening PID match; mismatch, missing service, timeout and changed source refuse.
requiredEvidence: Actual current-source tests and criterion-specific owner/Host/artifact receipts; no synthetic or structural-only substitution

acceptance.criterion: READY connection relays supported official Runtime6.3.3 MCP functions and preserves owner scope, authorization, results, errors and request IDs; no plugin permission escalation.
requiredEvidence: Actual current-source tests and criterion-specific owner/Host/artifact receipts; no synthetic or structural-only substitution

acceptance.criterion: Existing service private API configuration is used locally; no raw credentials in chat/artifact/log/argv; no copying or modifying existing data, credentials or model profile.
requiredEvidence: Actual current-source tests and criterion-specific owner/Host/artifact receipts; no synthetic or structural-only substitution

acceptance.criterion: Missing/invalid configuration and readiness accurately refuse affected work; unknown mutation outcomes never auto-retry; no global/private fallback.
requiredEvidence: Actual current-source tests and criterion-specific owner/Host/artifact receipts; no synthetic or structural-only substitution

acceptance.criterion: Plugin0.1.0 has complete pinned public dependencies, supported macOS arm64/Node24.14 prerequisites, finite install/doctor and declared exclusions; no private helpers.
requiredEvidence: Actual current-source tests and criterion-specific owner/Host/artifact receipts; no synthetic or structural-only substitution

acceptance.criterion: Exact accepted bytes pass current Codex Desktop selected start/status/real supported call, continued/new-chat reuse, ordinary-chat and failure controls.
requiredEvidence: Actual current-source tests and criterion-specific owner/Host/artifact receipts; no synthetic or structural-only substitution

acceptance.criterion: Focused positive/negative tests and actual stable-product compatibility pass; published dependency bytes are not modified and previous work/uncertain records remain retained.
requiredEvidence: Actual current-source tests and criterion-specific owner/Host/artifact receipts; no synthetic or structural-only substitution

acceptance.criterion: Freeze exact accepted plugin package, source and public dependency identities; candidate acceptance and owner release gates pass before publication. Public readback and reinstallation remain mandatory separate postpublication checks.
requiredEvidence: Actual current-source tests and criterion-specific owner/Host/artifact receipts; no synthetic or structural-only substitution

release.interpretation: User delegated conditional release and reiterated continue publication after the actual new-conversation test. Operator verified the scoped core criteria; this is not a new human approval claim.

notes: First plugin release has no earlier released plugin acceptance baseline. Stable Runtime/Expert are unchanged pinned dependencies, not newly released or claimed reaccepted products.

Prior large-scope Targets remain incomplete, retained and excluded from this release. RELEASE criterion includes postpublication readback, which must not be required before publication authorization: prepublication candidate acceptance and postpublication closure are explicitly separated in release evaluator.

definitions.criterion: Download the published GitHub release plugin artifact and match original accepted bytes.
Install those publicly downloaded bytes and repeat scoped current Codex Desktop start/status/operation/ordinary-chat checks.
